DAM-58: revert wrong PRs 496-500 from endfather (#504)

## Summary
- remove the misplaced cornerstone record and liquibase migrations introduced by PRs #496, #498, and #500
- restore the boogie, statistics, and labelexpert woodii files to their pre-merge state before PRs #497, #498, and #499
- preserve the later DAM-57 follow-up on `main` while removing the remaining net effect of these wrong-repo merges

## Why
- DAM-58 tracks that PRs #496, #497, #498, #499, and #500 were merged into the wrong repository and must be reverted from `endfather`
- PR #503 already renamed the statistics Flyway records migration to `V00000201__add_statistics_chart_nodes.sql`; this revert removes that renamed file together with the rest of the incorrect changes
